final: WITH regional_stats AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_count) as region_avg FROM (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3) GROUP BY region), district_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), above_avg_dist AS (SELECT dc.district_id, dc.region, dc.account_count, dc.account_count - rs.region_avg as exceeds FROM district_counts dc JOIN regional_stats rs ON dc.region = rs.region WHERE dc.account_count > rs.region_avg), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(account_count) as avg_val FROM above_avg_dist), with_ratio AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, exceeds, account_count / overall_avg.avg_val as ratio FROM above_avg_dist CROSS JOIN overall_avg), tenth_ratio AS (SELECT ratio FROM with_ratio ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, exceeds, ratio FROM with_ratio WHERE ratio >= (SELECT ratio FROM tenth_ratio) ORDER BY ratio DESC
